CACM-39.says: the algorithm produces "a single clearing price for each bidding zone and market time unit in EUR/MWh" (39(2)(a))
CACM-39.title: CACM Article 39 "Inputs and results of the price coupling algorithm", paragraph 2, as adopted

CACM-47.says: day-ahead gate closure is "noon market time day-ahead" (47(2)); "Orders matched in single day-ahead coupling shall be considered firm" (47(5))
CACM-47.title: Commission Regulation (EU) 2015/1222 (CACM), Article 47 "Operation of single day-ahead coupling", as adopted

CACM-48.says: each TSO verifies the results against allocation constraints and validated capacity, and each NEMO against the orders, before market participants are informed (48(2)-(4))
CACM-48.title: CACM Article 48 "Delivery of results", as adopted

CACM-50.says: if results cannot be delivered by the deadline, the fallback procedures apply and a notice is published
CACM-50.title: CACM Article 50 "Initiation of fallback procedures", as adopted

DOSSIER-6.says: dated NCEP production-status captures 2017-05..2026-09 put the 00 UTC GFS "48hr PRODUCTS" completion at 03:42-04:00 UTC (30-day running averages); reconstructed, not a per-day delivery proof
DOSSIER-6.title: reports/weather-admission/dossier.md §6 and availability/gfs_ncep_production_status.csv

MOP-A69.says: the A69 day-ahead wind/solar forecast is the forecast fixed at 18:00 Brussels time on D-1: after the gate
MOP-A69.title: reports/cp15/feasibility/structural_inputs.md (ENTSO-E MoP Ref2 pp.69-70)

RECON.says: SMARD day-ahead prices equal ENTSO-E A44 on all 120 sampled overlapping hours (max abs diff 0.0 EUR/MWh)
RECON.title: data/reconciliation_summary.json (snapshot pull, 2026-09-08)

REG543-12.says: the day-ahead prices in each bidding zone for every market time unit are "published no later than one hour after gate closure"; the provision carries no update or revision wording
REG543-12.title: Commission Regulation (EU) No 543/2013, Article 12, paragraphs 1(d) and 2(d), as adopted

REG543-6.says: a day-ahead forecast of the total load per market time unit is published "no later than two hours before the gate closure of the day-ahead market in the bidding zone" and updated "when significant changes occur"
REG543-6.title: Commission Regulation (EU) No 543/2013, Article 6 "Information on total load", paragraphs 1(b) and 2(b), as adopted

SMARD-B1.3.says: all SMARD data are updated on new information, without a fixed revision process; series follow TSO updates on the ENTSO-E platform; provisional data can later be replaced by quality-assured data
SMARD-B1.3.title: SMARD.de Benutzerhandbuch, April 2026, §B 1.3 "Aktualisierung der Daten" (p. 7)

SMARD-D2.2.1.says: TSOs forecast next-day total load under Art. 6(1)(b) Reg. 543/2013, sent to ENTSO-E at the latest two hours before the day-ahead closure; an update of published data is required when values change by at least 10%
SMARD-D2.2.1.title: SMARD.de Benutzerhandbuch, April 2026, §D 2.2.1 "Prognostizierter Stromverbrauch: Gesamt" (p. 52)

SMARD-D3.1.says: day-ahead prices under Art. 12(1)(d) Reg. 543/2013 are published at the latest one hour after the bid closure; "Eine nachträgliche Aktualisierung der veröffentlichten Daten ist möglich"; DE-LU prices reach ENTSO-E through a third-party provider for the German TSOs
SMARD-D3.1.title: SMARD.de Benutzerhandbuch, April 2026, §D 3.1 "Großhandelspreise" (p. 54)

missing_input_rules.consequence: failure: no forecast for that row; a day without a feature-valid row fails (the day falls back, §24.7)
missing_input_rules.member: v1-R and the CP-15 base features of every v2-v5 member
missing_input_rules.rule: a calendar-day/local-hour lag whose source hour is unavailable or ambiguous is null; a 168/720-hour window with any missing hour is NaN; a row with any null base feature gets no forecast and is not eligible

missing_input_rules.consequence: failure: B0 has no forecast for that hour
missing_input_rules.rule: Tue-Fri take D-1, Mon/Sat/Sun take D-7 by calendar day and local hour; an unavailable or ambiguous source hour is null

missing_input_rules.consequence: imputed inside the design; the row itself still needs every base feature (cp15/data.py:104)
missing_input_rules.input: price curves D-1, D-2, D-3, D-7 (LEAR cross-hour design)
missing_input_rules.rule: a missing local-hour value takes the training-partition median with a missing indicator (fitted on training rows only)
a forecast day without finite origin statistics raises a training failure; training days without them leave the window

missing_input_rules.input: prices: released errors for the H layer (<= D-2)
missing_input_rules.rule: issuance needs 28 complete released days; fewer raises

missing_input_rules.consequence: failure of the whole delivery day (the day falls back, §24.7); it is an eligibility exclusion in the calendar
missing_input_rules.member: v1-R and every v2-v5 member through the base features
missing_input_rules.rule: any missing or null hour of D's load forecast makes the day mean NaN, so every row of D lacks a base feature, is not feature-valid and gets no forecast

missing_input_rules.consequence: imputed; the row still needs D's own base features
missing_input_rules.input: load forecast lags D-1, D-7 (load_d1, load_d7) and D (load_d0) inside LEAR / DDNN-2 designs
missing_input_rules.rule: training-partition median imputation with missing indicators (LEAR); winsorise, then median imputation (DDNN-2)

missing_input_rules.consequence: imputed, never a failure, once every development day has a weather record (CP-25 fills the gaps)
missing_input_rules.member: v3, v4, v5 (A1_w, B2_w, L-N, L-R, DDNN-2 gfs group)
missing_input_rules.rule: §15.3: a confirmed missing, late or invalid weather vector sets all three columns missing and their indicators; training-only median imputation. A row with no frozen weather record at all is refused (BLOCKED, never imputed)
deterministic; computed for every hour, never missing

published_inputs.against_issue_time: a training target of delivery day D-1 was published by D-2 13:00, at least 22 h before D-1 11:00; day D's own price is published after the issue time and is the embargoed target (§24.4)
published_inputs.basis: tier 2: preserved original values (SDAC results are firm), availability reconstructed from the documented deadline
published_inputs.documented_publication: auction day D-1 for delivery D: no later than one hour after the 12:00 Europe/Berlin gate, i.e. 13:00 local
published_inputs.finality: documented: matched SDAC orders are firm (CACM 47(5)); the algorithm produces one clearing price per zone and MTU (39(2)(a)), verified by TSOs and NEMOs before delivery (48(2)-(4)); the publication duty (Reg. 543/2013 Art. 12) has no update wording, unlike the load forecast's (Art. 6). Caveat, disclosed: SMARD states that a later update of the published price data is possible (SMARD-D3.1) and that its series follow TSO corrections (SMARD-B1.3); no historical price vintage exists to show none occurred. The snapshot equals ENTSO-E A44 on 120 sampled hours (RECON).
published_inputs.input: target price (SDAC DE-LU day-ahead clearing price; training targets and scoring truth)

published_inputs.against_issue_time: strictly before D-1 11:00 by at least 22 h on every day under the documented deadline
published_inputs.basis: tier 2, the same values and evidence as the target price
published_inputs.documented_publication: the latest price used, delivery day D-1's, is published by D-2 13:00 Europe/Berlin
published_inputs.input: price lags and price statistics (B0's D-1/D-7; v1-R's 24/48/168 h lags and 168/720 h statistics; LEAR's D-1, D-2, D-3, D-7 curves; DDNN-2's D-1 curve, optional D-2/D-3/D-7 and statistics; the 168 h normalisation; the H layer's released errors <= D-2; v1-R's CQR calibration D-61..D-2)

published_inputs.basis: tier 3: originality cannot be established (§24.5), the known risk the anchor names; no tier-1/2 substitute exists in the preserved data
published_inputs.documented_publication: no later than two hours before the 12:00 day-ahead gate: D-1 10:00 Europe/Berlin (Reg. 543/2013 Art. 6(2)(b))
published_inputs.finality: not established: the forecast must be updated when values change significantly (Art. 6(2)(b)), by at least 10% (SMARD-D2.2.1); SMARD follows TSO updates without a fixed revision process (SMARD-B1.3). The snapshot holds SMARD's values as pulled on 2026-09-08, with no issue or update timestamps, so whether any value is the original D-1 10:00 issue cannot be established
